item.title: Dispatch Core [ALPHA]
item.description:
Your lines depart on time: timetables at the termini, measured statistics for
your whole network, and reserve vehicles recalled in one click when a
departure is at risk.

[b]What the mod does[/b]

[b]Measured statistics[/b] — The mod watches your vehicles and computes, for
every line: trip time, real frequency, average stop, load and speed. Nothing
to configure, everything is measured as you play, and the measurements
survive saving and loading.

[b]Timetables at the termini[/b] — Pick a line, switch it to Timetable mode,
add the departures of each hour (for example h03 and h33): your vehicles will
leave the termini at those minutes. Three settings frame the rule: minimum
stop (floor), delay tolerance, and maximum hold (safety ceiling, so a vehicle
never waits forever).

[b]Reserve pool[/b] — Park a vehicle at any siding station from its vehicle
window: the parking line is created automatically, the vehicle drives there
on its own, and the line is removed once nobody uses it. When a slot is at
risk for lack of rolling stock, a window offers the available vehicles with
their distance and estimated arrival. You pick one, it goes straight to the
threatened terminus without serving intermediate stops. The reserve pool is
shared network-wide: any parked vehicle can rescue any compatible line.

[b]Built-in help[/b] — Dispatch menu > Help: three short recipes to get
started, plus the important warnings.

[b]What the mod does NOT do[/b]

[list]
[*] It NEVER touches your tracks, stations or lines: the only lever it uses
is holding vehicles at the platform.
[*] It never parks anything on its own: you decide, it executes.
[*] It does not replace the game's management: buying, selling and sending
to a depot remain yours.
[*] Combined behaviour with other scheduling mods (Timetables for instance)
is undefined: use only one regulation mod at a time.
[/list]

[b]Good to know[/b]

[list]
[*] A track-only station mod is required for clean sidings (see required
items).
[*] On a regulated line, set the GAME's minimum waiting time to zero at the
termini and use the mod's "Minimum stop" instead: otherwise both add up. The
mod warns you in the log.
[*] Very long lines (round trip approaching one hour of game time) cannot be
run on a timetable: the mod tells you.
[*] Removing the mod mid-game leaves vehicles held: recall your reserves
first.
[/list]

[b]ALPHA version[/b] — The mod works and has been tested,
but this is a first release. Feedback in the comments is welcome, especially
unexpected behaviour.

Interface and help translated into English, French and German.
